# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

## Differential Expression

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,
  or paired control with another baseline unless the task defines that contrast.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_raw = pd.read_csv('inputs/count.csv')
assert counts_raw.columns.tolist() == ['geneID','KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3']
counts_raw = counts_raw.set_index('geneID')
assert not counts_raw.index.duplicated().any()

def run(samples, label):
    counts = counts_raw[samples].T.astype(int)
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({'condition': ['KL' if s.startswith('KL') else 'WL' for s in samples]}, index=samples)
    dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=metadata, design='~condition', ref_level=['condition','WL'], quiet=True, n_cpus=1)
    dds.deseq2()
    stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','KL','WL'], alpha=0.05, quiet=True, n_cpus=1)
    stat.summary()
    print(label, 'coefficients:', list(dds.varm['LFC'].columns) if 'LFC' in dds.varm else 'no varm LFC')
    # coefficient name from the stats object/result columns/API
    print(label, 'stats contrast idx?', getattr(stat, 'contrast', None), 'coeff?', getattr(stat, 'contrast_idx', None))
    print(label, 'results columns before:', stat.results_df.columns.tolist())
    print(label, stat.results_df.head(2).to_string())
    # Try likely coefficient names.
    for coeff in ['condition_KL_vs_WL', 'condition[T.KL]', 'condition_KL_vs_WL']:
        try:
            st2 = stat
            st2.lfc_shrink(coeff=coeff)
            print(label, 'shrink coeff used:', coeff)
            break
        except Exception as e:
            last = e
    else:
        raise last
    res = st2.results_df.copy()
    sig = res[(res['baseMean'] > 10) & (res['pvalue'] < 0.05) & (res['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 1)]
    print(label, 'n_sig', int(sig.shape[0]))
    print(label, 'res cols after:', res.columns.tolist())
    print(label, 'p nonna', int(res['pvalue'].notna().sum()), 'padj nonna', int(res['padj'].notna().sum()))
    return int(sig.shape[0])

full = run(['KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3'], 'full')
reduced = run(['KL1','KL2','WL1','WL2'], 'reduced')
direction = 'increase' if reduced > full else 'decrease' if reduced < full else 'no change'
print('RESULT', full, reduced, direction)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
counts_raw = pd.read_csv('inputs/count.csv').set_index('geneID')

def run(samples, label):
    counts = counts_raw[samples].T.astype(int)
    cond = ['KL' if s.startswith('KL') else 'WL' for s in samples]
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({'condition': pd.Categorical(cond, categories=['WL','KL'])}, index=samples)
    dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=metadata, design='~condition', quiet=True, n_cpus=1)
    dds.deseq2()
    stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','KL','WL'], alpha=0.05, quiet=True, n_cpus=1)
    stat.summary()
    print(label, 'LFC columns', list(dds.varm['LFC'].columns))
    print(label, stat.results_df.head(1).to_string())
    coeffs = [c for c in dds.varm['LFC'].columns if c "'!= '"'Intercept']
    assert coeffs == ['condition[T.KL]'], coeffs
    stat.lfc_shrink(coeff='condition[T.KL]')
    res = stat.results_df.copy()
    sig = res[(res['baseMean'] > 10) & (res['pvalue'] < 0.05) & (res['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 1)]
    print(label, 'n_sig', int(sig.shape[0]), 'p_nonNA', int(res['pvalue'].notna().sum()), 'padj_nonNA', int(res['padj'].notna().sum()))
    print(label, 'up', int((sig['log2FoldChange'] > 1).sum()), 'down', int((sig['log2FoldChange'] < -1).sum()))
    return int(sig.shape[0])
full = run(['KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3'], 'full')
reduced = run(['KL1','KL2','WL1','WL2'], 'reduced')
direction = 'increase' if reduced > full else 'decrease' if reduced < full else 'no change'
print('RESULT', full, reduced, direction)
